question: Topical cyclosporine A 0.05% eye drops treat dry eye disease by suppressing T-lymphocyte-mediated inflammation at the ocular surface, thereby increasing functional tear production.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is TRUE. Cyclosporine A works as an anti-inflammatory immunomodulator (not as an artificial tear). It reduces T-cell-mediated inflammation, improving lacrimal gland function and tear production over 3–6 months of use.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Cyclosporine A (Restasis) is an immunomodulator — it blocks calcineurin, reducing T-cell activation and lacrimal gland inflammatory damage. It increases tear production by reducing inflammation, not by supplementing tears.
